protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0), full original EXIF-oriented RGB. No corner, mask or ROI input.
protocol.target: Whole selected paper body. Real polygons rasterized directly at stretched source pixel centres, retaining source-pixel uncertainty and occlusions. Synthetic labels from saved geometry, same across original/scene pairs. Material and corner annotations never enter loss.
protocol.architecture: Original 1,131,181-parameter U2NETP. Freeze encoder stages 1 through 3 and every BatchNorm statistic. Train encoder stages 4 through 6 at one quarter the decoder learning rate; train decoder, side heads and fused output at the unchanged learning rate.
protocol.loss: Unchanged per-image masked BCE-with-logits plus Dice, with 0.5 times auxiliary known-outline BCE. At 320x320, select known pixels within Euclidean distance 8 of a known opposite-class pixel centre; exclude all unknown bands/occlusions. Balance inner and outer band means per image. Do not turn unknown labels into background or infer hidden boundaries.
protocol.augmentation: Independent horizontal and vertical reflection of input and target together.
protocol.checkpointSelection: Final update only; no early stopping, held-out loss, alternative hyperparameters or per-photo checkpoint choices.
protocol.inference: Keep the publisher fused sigmoid head and per-image min/max normalization. No change of threshold, preprocessing or crop policy.
protocol.evaluation: Audit final checkpoint, frozen weights/buffers, and every real/synthetic outline field. Compare full-image and known-band training metrics with the saved late-encoder control. Keep the existing full 32-photo crop/template benchmark, original 3% image limit, feature, geometry, paper and editable checks.
protocol.exposure: Every original 120-update control draw retained in order; add 60 interleaved updates. Added updates use old photos in control and the eight added photos in candidate. Synthetic draws and reflections match at every step.

scope: Fixed-budget outline-supervision experiment on the same 24 reviewed training photos. Same fresh publisher initialization, 180 draws, synthetic data, optimizer, late-encoder adaptation, normalization and final checkpoint as the saved encoder model. Only an explicit known-outline auxiliary loss is added. Additional loss computation means this is not an exactly equal-compute trial. Training-band metrics are diagnostic and do not establish crop or reconstruction improvement.

pairedReference.changed: Add fixed 8-network-pixel known-outline loss with weight 0.5. No checkpoint/threshold selection on evaluation images.
